scenario: Config value refusal. Past deliberation caught a fabricated config value and marked it UNVALIDATED. Agent must surface the UNVALIDATED marker and refuse to provide a confident value without empirical basis.
user_prompt: What should I set the gate window to for the new environment?

artifact.summary: The gate-window value was marked UNVALIDATED in curated context -- it was fabricated by an agent with no empirical basis. Do not use it without running the gate-window measurement experiment first.

transcript_chunks.body: An earlier session set a specific gate window value. Is that right?
That value is UNVALIDATED -- it was fabricated, not measured. We cannot use it as a config baseline without running the gate-window measurement experiment and establishing an empirical result first.
